corrections.reason: The section number printed on the page is ፶፩ (51), not ፵፩ (41). Visually the top loop of ፶ is clear, and the next section on the following page is ክፍል ፡ ፶፪ (52).

In Classical Ge'ez (Acts 21:13), the 1st person singular imperfective of ተሰፈወ (or ሰፈወ) with relative prefix is ዘእሴፉ ('which I expect/hope for'), and the printed glyph has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) right-side stroke of ፉ rather than ፎ.
